name: setup-manaflow-ai-gel-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: one seed color's tonal palette for light and dark in a theme file, Roboto and roomy rows in settings, filled tonal containers with large soft corners and no hairlines in a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens, and a hover card of tonal chips on glass. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Gel sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Gel's hover card and sidebar rows: a headline, a tonal status chip on glass, the task, and the branch as chips.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
